_about: Settings for the site build. Edit this file (not the script) to change which facilities are shown or when CMS publishes new fixed thresholds.

area._about: Facilities within radius_miles (straight line) of the origin ZIP are shown. also_include_ccns / exclude_ccns override the radius. fallback_ccns is only used if a CMS file ever arrives without latitude/longitude.
area._also_include_note: 295011 = South Lyon Medical Center, Yerington (about 50.2 mi, just outside the line)

regions._about: Region label by 'STATE:COUNTY', then by state, then default.

staffing_ranges._source: CMS Five-Star Technical Users' Guide, Sept 2026, Table 3 (max 380 points)

qm_ranges._source: CMS Five-Star Technical Users' Guide, Sept 2026, Table 5 (effective July 2026). CMS may raise these again in January 2027.

health_cut_points_official._about: Optional. Health inspection star cut points from CMS's monthly State-Level Cut Point Table (upper bound of each star band, lower score is better). Set use to true to show these instead of the estimate the build makes from the uploaded file.
